tagline.en: Robert Moses's expressway through four of the five boroughs
tagline.zh: 罗伯特·摩西修穿纽约五区中四区的快速路

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

start.en: US 1/9 near the Goethals Bridge, New Jersey
start.zh: 新泽西州，戈瑟尔斯桥附近的 US 1/9

end.zh: 布朗克斯区，布鲁克纳枢纽立交

en: I-278 is not one road but four expressways strung together with bridges: the Staten Island Expressway, the Gowanus Expressway, the Brooklyn–Queens Expressway and the Bruckner Expressway, joined by the Goethals, Verrazzano-Narrows, Kosciuszko and Robert F. Kennedy crossings. It touches four of New York City's five boroughs and a corner of New Jersey. The even hundreds digit implies a loop off I-78, a relationship that exists on paper rather more than it does on the ground.

The Brooklyn section is the part that matters most and suffers most. It is the only Interstate in the borough and, because trucks are barred from the East River bridges' parkway alternatives and from the Hudson tunnels, it is the primary road link between Long Island and everything west of it. A New York City Council review counted around 153,000 vehicles on a typical weekday, of which as many as 25,000 — sixteen per cent — were heavy vehicles, with up to 1,100 trucks an hour during the weekday morning peak.
zh: I-278 并不是一条路，而是用桥梁串起来的四条快速路：斯塔滕岛快速路、高瓦纳斯快速路、布鲁克林—皇后区快速路和布鲁克纳快速路，由戈瑟尔斯桥、韦拉扎诺海峡大桥、科希丘什科桥与罗伯特·肯尼迪大桥连接。它经过纽约市五个区中的四个，外加新泽西州的一角。偶数百位按惯例意味着它是 I-78 的环线，但这层关系更多存在于纸面上，而不是地面上。
布鲁克林段最重要，也最受罪。它是该区唯一的州际公路；又因为卡车不得走东河桥梁一侧的景观道路，也不得走哈德逊河隧道，它成了长岛与其以西一切地方之间最主要的道路联系。纽约市议会的一份评估统计，平常工作日约有 153,000 辆车通行，其中重型车最多可达 25,000 辆，占 16%；工作日早高峰每小时的卡车数量可达 1,100 辆。

en: Planning for the Brooklyn–Queens Expressway began in 1936 and construction ran, with a wartime pause, from 1937 to 1964 under Robert Moses. By the time the six-lane road was finished it had cost $137 million including construction, land and relocation. Its most-copied piece of engineering came out of a fight it lost: rather than drive the road along Hicks Street and split Brooklyn Heights, Moses accepted a triple cantilever, three roadways stacked against the slope above the East River, with a public promenade laid on top. That section opened in 1954.

The compromise at Brooklyn Heights was the exception. Along the rest of its twelve-mile course through Brooklyn the expressway displaced tens of thousands of residents and took out homes and businesses wholesale, and the neighbourhoods either side of it have been arguing about the consequences ever since. Rebuilding started almost immediately: work on the Long Island Expressway interchange began in 1966, two years after the road was declared complete.
zh: 布鲁克林—皇后区快速路的规划始于 1936 年，施工自 1937 年至 1964 年，其间因战争中断，主持者是罗伯特·摩西。这条六车道道路建成时，连同施工、征地与安置在内共耗资 1.37 亿美元。它最常被引用的工程手法，恰恰来自一场它输掉的争执：摩西没有沿希克斯街把路推过去、把布鲁克林高地一劈为二，而是接受了「三层悬臂」方案——三层路面叠靠在东河之上的坡地上，顶上再铺一条公共步道。该段于 1954 年通车。
布鲁克林高地的妥协只是例外。在它穿越布鲁克林的十二英里其余路段上，这条快速路迫使数以万计的居民迁离，成片拆除了住宅与商铺，两侧的社区至今仍在为其后果争论不休。重建几乎立刻就开始了：1966 年，也就是全线宣告完工两年之后，长岛快速路交汇处的改造工程便已动工。

en: The triple cantilever is now the most closely watched half-mile of road in New York. The 0.4-mile structure is roughly twenty years past its design life and carries about 130,000 vehicles a day, more than double what it was built for, including all 13,000 of the daily truck trips that have no legal alternative. Sensors weigh trucks as they cross; the city's own weigh-in-motion study found that about ten per cent of them exceed legal weight limits.

Holding it together is expensive and temporary. About a fifth of the deck needs local repairs every three years and the whole deck needs milling and paving on the same cycle, at an estimated $7.3 million a year in 2023 dollars. Left alone, New York City DOT's own projections had the structure taking weight restrictions after 2028 and closing entirely by 2036. In August 2026 the city committed to a rehabilitation with construction planned from 2030, noting that every year of delay adds about $160 million in escalation.
zh: 三层悬臂段如今是纽约被盯得最紧的半英里路。这段 0.4 英里的结构已超出设计寿命约二十年，每日承载约 130,000 辆车，是设计流量的两倍多，其中包括每日 13,000 趟别无合法替代路线的卡车。传感器会在卡车通过时称重；纽约市自己的动态称重研究发现，其中约一成超过法定重量上限。
维持它既昂贵又只是权宜之计。约五分之一的桥面每三年需要局部修补，整个桥面也需按同样周期铣刨重铺，按 2023 年币值估算每年约 730 万美元。若放任不管，纽约市交通局自己的推算是：2028 年之后该结构将不得不限重，到 2036 年将完全封闭。2026 年 8 月，市政府确定实施大修，计划 2030 年开工，并指出每拖延一年就会多出约 1.6 亿美元的造价上涨。

why.en: Published estimates for rebuilding the city-owned central section differ substantially between accounts, no contract has been awarded and no funding package is settled, so quoting a single number here would be misleading.
why.zh: 关于重建市属中段的公开估算在不同报道之间差距很大，工程尚未发包，资金方案也未落实，因此在此给出单一数字会造成误导。
